The demo's check rules this disagreement decidable with instruments that exist today and names the shared observable both claims bear on. This is a statement about the two claim cards, not a verdict on either theory. The axis is an axis of theoretical commitment, not a quantity axis, so no margin or floor applies. The claim statements in the linked claim cards are reviewed paraphrases with page locators, not quotations.

left.statement: IIT predicts that the duration of a conscious instant is definite and sustained over tens to hundreds of milliseconds, not transient or phasic, as required by the exclusion postulate governing the cause–effect structure of the PSC.

right.statement: Conscious processing is serial and all-or-none: at any moment only one interpretation reaches consciousness, and access to one item prevents or delays conscious access to a competing item.
